title: String Theory
text: String theory is a theoretical framework in physics in which the point-like particles of particle physics are replaced by one-dimensional objects called strings. These strings vibrate at different frequencies, with each vibrational mode corresponding to a different elementary particle. String theory attempts to reconcile general relativity and quantum mechanics, which are otherwise incompatible at the Planck scale. The theory requires additional spatial dimensions beyond the usual three, typically 10 or 11 total dimensions. While string theory has produced significant mathematical insights, it has not yet made unique testable predictions, leading to ongoing debate about its status as a scientific theory.
